notes.title: Feed The Gods Release Date
notes.notes:
Dear Cultists,

The Ancient One stir, hungry for devotion and sacrifice. 
Feed The Gods emerges from the shadows, summoning you to prove your worth. On Friday The 13, the ritual begins—an easy-to-learn, yet unforgiving card battle experience steeped in the dread of dark dungeons and the echo of haunting chants. 

Or simply to say - mark your calendars, Feed The Gods will be released on December 13th! 

Prepare your offerings, sharpen your wits, and ready yourselves to face the unfathomable. They are waiting —will you answer their call?..

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2918960/Feed_The_Gods

notes.title: Dev Diary #4 - Release Date and future plans!
notes.notes:
Dear Cult Leaders,

TedRed team here. 

Wow, It's been a long time since we've been in touch. And 2024 is almost at an end. But it doesn't mean that we forgot about Feed The Gods. We have a lot of good news!

RELEASE SOON

We'll post an announcement in near future, so stay tuned!

And here are some features to look forward to in the game at release:

 Multiplayer support for up to 6 people
 Deck building Mode
 20+ hand drawn animated avatars
 French, Chinese and Russian localization
 Achievements
 Very hungry Ancient One who is ready to accept your sacrifices…

Of course, you'll have to play a bit at the beginning to get all the bonuses. But we believe in you!
If you're still in doubt - a demo of our game is always available, give it a try :)

ACHIEVEMENTS

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45044568/2c9084800f285ed413d00a2a2d15269b56778905.jpg

If you've read our previous dev blogs, you know how hard it is sometimes to stop our artist.
He decided it was time for drawing some achievements. Without further ado - we'll just show them to you right now.

BUGS


If during the game you have any problems / bugs / you found a typo - do not hesitate to write to us in Steam Discussions or our Discord channel!
Any comment will help us make the game better.


That’s the end of our fourth Dev Diary! Here's the link to push a 'Wishlist' button :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2918960/Feed_The_Gods/

Be the first to know about it and join our Discord!
And please ask any questions in Discussions!

notes.title: Dev Diary #2 - Tutorial Update
notes.notes:
Dear Cult Leaders,

TedRed team’s here! 

We’re making some progress at full speed. There are still so many things we want to do! 
But more on that later. Today we’ll share some details about the tutorial. And a few other details as a bonus 🙂


TUTORIAL
There’s no game without a tutorial. Our game had one too. However, only in picture form...
Last playtest showed us that things are not as easy as they seem. We spent a lot of time explaining how the basic game loop works in Discord, while playing with our testers.
After many hours of internal discussions and several versions, we finally have a full-fledged tutorial!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45044568/8acb196843d7a818ce8273313f9a007b54163b0b.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45044568/34cab34960646e898d124647f3620d956d791026.png

The tutorial will show you:

what is your main purpose in the game
how to use cards and what they mean
about the player's turn itself
and the opponent's turn of course
all UI tips you need to understand

The tutorial button will always be in the game. If you forget something, you can always replay it.

NEW AVATARS
Even though the main visuals of the game are ready, we’re always thinking about what else we can add to the game.
Besides new features, we want to add some fancy things. That's why we’ve expanded the number of avatars. For all players of all tastes. Cool, right? 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45044568/3d844216f9e3cb7a163a119949ddb6ee325dd1f7.gif


That’s the end of our second Dev Diary!

If you're not already wishlisting Feed The Gods, consider doing it:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2918960/Feed_The_Gods/

Be the first to know about it and join our Discord - https://discord.gg/UKfZNgVKud

PS: please ask any questions in Discussions! We’re always happy to chat :)
